title: Entry Thresholds for the Keyturn Host Payout Schedules
content:
Each of the six schedules a Keyturn Host Payout Account may settle under carries an earnings floor, a trip floor and a tenure floor. Those floors are the terms of the schedule.

## Floors by schedule

| Payout schedule | Monthly earnings floor | Settled trips floor | Tenure floor |
|---|---|---|---|
| Standard | 0.00 USD | 0 | 0 days |
| Weekly Batch | 0.00 USD | 3 | 30 days |
| Express | 500.00 USD | 10 | 60 days |
| Instant | 1200.00 USD | 25 | 90 days |
| Fleet Settlement | 8000.00 USD | 100 | 180 days |
| Reserve-Backed Settlement | 20000.00 USD | 150 | 365 days |

## Reading of the floors

- **Monthly earnings floor** is the monthly earnings a host needs to hold that schedule.
- **Settled trips floor** is the settled trips a host needs to hold it.
- **Tenure floor** is the calendar days a host must have been on the marketplace to hold it.

The Keyturn Standard Payout Schedule asks nothing on any of the three. The Keyturn Weekly Batch Payout Schedule asks 3 settled trips and 30 days, with no earnings floor. From the Keyturn Express Payout Schedule upward all three floors bite: 500.00 USD, 10 trips and 60 days on the Keyturn Express Payout Schedule; 1200.00 USD, 25 trips and 90 days on the Keyturn Instant Payout Schedule; 8000.00 USD, 100 trips and 180 days on the Keyturn Fleet Settlement Schedule; and 20000.00 USD, 150 trips and 365 days on the Keyturn Reserve-Backed Settlement Schedule.
